purpose: Teach: うたっ/短所/ふえる/ぼけ/なつ/やれやれ/人当たり/留まっ

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、学校で、皆と、お歌、うたったよ、本当に、楽しかったよ。
lines.en: Mom — we sang songs at school with everyone today. It was really fun!
lines.style: Bright, eager opening. Quick pace, almost tumbling over words with genuine excitement. The openness of a child who has something good to share.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。翔くんの短所、気にしすぎないでね、ママは、長所を、いっぱい、知ってるからね。
lines.en: That's wonderful. Don't worry so much about the things that are hard for you — Mom sees all the good things in you.
lines.style: Warm and reassuring, spoken directly to him. Soft, steady delivery. The tone of a mother offering quiet protection without making it heavy.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お友達、最近、教室に、ふえることが、ほぼ、毎週、あるよ、ママ、新しい子、ね。
lines.en: Mom, there are new kids coming to class almost every week now. There's this new boy.
lines.style: Genuinely engaged, talking a little faster. The specificity of a child noticing something real. Not performing — just sharing what's on his mind.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、最近、ちょっと、ぼけてきたかな、家族で、心配してるわよね、翔くん、優しくしてね。
lines.en: Grandpa's been a little forgetful lately, and the family's been worried about him. Be gentle with him, okay?
lines.style: Slightly softer tone, careful not to alarm. A gentle shift downward — speaking something that matters but with the lightness of a mother who doesn't want to burden her child with adult worry.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: なつ、ぼくの新しいお友達、本当に、優しい子なんだよ、ママ、紹介したいよ、絶対。
lines.en: Natsu — my new friend — he's such a kind person, Mom. I really want to introduce him to you.
lines.style: Warm and sincere, with real conviction. The opening is genuine, not performance. Builds with want — 'I really want to' carries the weight of genuine care.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: やれやれ、お父さん、今日も、忙しそうね、本当に、心配だわ、お母さんとして、絶対。
lines.en: Oh, your dad's so busy lately. I really do worry about him, as his mother I can't help it.
lines.style: A wry, affectionate exhale. Not complaints — the small, loving exasperation of a wife watching her husband push too hard. Slightly self-aware, maybe a hint of dry humor.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お祖母ちゃん、人当たりが、いい人だよね、ママ、いつも、皆に、優しいよ、本当に。
lines.en: Grandma's so good with people, isn't she? She's always kind to everyone.
lines.style: Thoughtful and soft. The tone of a child noticing something true about someone he loves. Not asking — observing. A small moment of quiet reflection.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 昨日、お父さんから、メール、留まったから、本当に、安心したわよ、翔くん、お父さん、無事ね、絶対。
lines.en: Yesterday your dad sent me a message and it made me feel so much better. Your dad's safe — thank goodness.
lines.style: Relief and warmth, like a weight lifting. Opening softly — the comfort of reassurance received. The tenderness of a wife who worries and a mother who's been reminded that her family is okay.
